newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algerian rebels kill 20 near capital - APS.
newsitem.headline: Algerian rebels kill 20 near capital - APS.

text.p: Algerian Moslem fundamentalists killed 20 people and wounded seven in an attack on a bus in Blida province just south of the capital Algiers early on Wednesday, security forces said.
An official statement carried by the official Algerian news agency APS said the attack took place at 3 a.m. in Benhamdani in the district of Benkhelil.
Nearly 60 people have been killed in Blida province in less than a week in attacks the authorities blame on Islamist rebels. The provincial capital Blida is 50 km (30 miles) from Algiers.
Moslem rebels killed eight civilians in the village of Amroussa, in Blida province, on Monday night, authorities reported earlier.

An estimated 60,000 people have died in Algeria's war between security forces and Moslem rebels which began in January 1992 when the military-backed government cancelled a general election that the fundamentalist Islamic Salvation Front was poised to win.
